description: 臺南市公共管線圖資-配電系統電桿 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺南市政府工務局. 提供臺南市公共管線圖資-配電系統電桿，包含全市37區道路範圍圖資。 公共管線圖資係由轄區管線單位提供，其圖資僅供參考，如需取得詳細資料，仍須跟各管線單位洽詢。. Coverage: 臺南市政府工務局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺南市政府工務局. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in wms. The portal shows 2025-12-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
